name: Minimalist Grayscale Pitch
tagline: Black-white pitch deck with large angular blocks, thin diagonal rules, airy uppercase type, and monochrome image frames.

palette.description: White, black, charcoal, and pale gray with thin silver line accents.

typography.style: Thin uppercase geometric sans paired with large monochrome angular shapes.

best_for: Startup pitch decks, concise business plans, monochrome executive updates, and design-forward company introductions.
avoid_for: Warm culture decks, colorful education content, or highly decorative brand stories.

source_inspiration.name: Slidesgo Minimalist Grayscale Pitch Deck
source_inspiration.notes: Rebuilt as source-inspired portable HTML/CSS from public visual references; no source asset files are embedded.
